verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's docs claim comprehensive, context-aware, agentic review with PR prioritization, incremental/full review modes, and one-click fix actions that could plausibly handle volume beyond human review capacity (coderabbit-docs-1,3,13,15,17). However, hands-on community reports concretely contradict the 'holds the line' framing: one team reported it 'mostly too verbose, catching too many false positives and never really added anything useful' and removed it (coderabbit-comm-2), and another reported that during an actual exploit test, CodeRabbit posted a comment claiming it caught a critical security risk while the exploit still executed successfully (coderabbit-comm-4) — a concrete failure of the verification claim in practice, alongside positive corroboration elsewhere (coderabbit-comm-1,6). missing for 10: independent volume/throughput benchmarks showing it scales to AI-authored PR volume no human team could match, and resolution of the documented false-positive/verification-gap reports.
